acceptOwnership().details: Only the pending owner can accept the ownership transfer.

claim(uint256,address,uint256,bytes32[]).details: Anyone can claim tokens on behalf of an account.

params.account: The address to claim tokens for.
params.distributionIndex: The index of the distribution to claim tokens for.
params.proof: The merkle proof that validates this claim.

params.allowlistEnabled_: Whether the distributor allowlist is enabled.
params.feePercentage_: The fee percentage taken from the distributed amount

distribute(address,uint256,bytes32,uint2.details: There is deliberately no unguarded overload. A funder always reads the state it is      funding against, so "skip this check" is an option with no legitimate caller and one      obvious wrong caller: the convenient one. `feeRecipient` can never be zero      (`_setFeeRecipient`), so a zero `expectedFeeRecipient` is a caller that forgot rather      than a caller that opted out, and is rejected as such.

params.amount: The amount of token to distribute.
params.claimDeadline: The timestamp after which claims close (0 = no expiry, never sweepable).
params.expectedFeeRecipient: The fee recipient the funder is agreeing to pay.
params.expectedRoot: The merkle root the funder is funding against.
params.expectedTotalMerkleValue: The payout denominator committed by that root.
params.maxFeeAmount: The most the funder will pay in fees, in token units.

params.limit: The number of addresses to return.
The number of distributions to return.

returns._0: True if the address is in the allowlist.

pause().details: Expired sweeps remain available so pausing cannot remove a funder's only exit.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

params.allowlistEnabled_: Whether the distributor allowlist is enabled.

setFeePercentage(uint256).details: M-7: a DECREASE applies immediately (it cannot take a funder's money); an INCREASE is      only scheduled here — it becomes claimable via `applyFeePercentageIncrease` after      `FEE_INCREASE_DELAY`, so a funder always has time to see it coming.

params.newMerkleSnapshot: The new merkle snapshot contract address.

sweep(uint256).details: Permissionless: anyone may trigger the sweep, but funds always go to      `distribution.distributor` (the round funder). Only callable once the      claim window has closed (`claimDeadline != 0 && block.timestamp > claimDeadline`),      so a sweep can never race a valid claim.

params.distributionIndex: The index of the distribution to sweep.

returns.sweptAmount: The amount of unclaimed funds returned to the funder.

params.newOwner: The new owner of the contract.

params.canDistribute_: The distributor's ability to distribute funds.

FEE_INCREASE_DELAY().notice: Delay before a scheduled fee-percentage INCREASE takes effect (M-7, 2026-08-13         audit): the owner could `setFeePercentage(100%)` in front of a funder's         `distribute` and capture the whole round. Increases now announce themselves and         wait; decreases and recipient changes stay immediate (they cannot take a funder's         money). Funders wanting a per-round guarantee also have the guarded `distribute`         overload with `maxFeeAmount` / `expectedFeeRecipient`.

FEE_RANGE().notice: The range of the fee percentage.

allowlistEnabled().notice: Whether the distributor allowlist is enabled.

applyFeePercentageIncrease().notice: Applies a scheduled fee-percentage increase once its delay has elapsed (M-7).         Callable by anyone — the schedule, not the caller, is the authority.

claim(uint256,address,uint256,bytes32[]).notice: Claims tokens for a given distribution.

claimed(uint256,address).notice: The `amount` claimed by `account` for a given distribution.

distribute(address,uint256,bytes32,uint2.notice: Distributes funds against fully pinned state. Every guard is mandatory: the round         reverts unless the root, the payout denominator, the fee recipient and the fee the         funder was shown are all still exactly what they were when the funder decided.

feePercentage().notice: The fee percentage taken from the distributed amount.

getAllowlist().notice: Returns all addresses in the allowlist.

getAllowlistAt(uint256).notice: Returns the address at a given index in the allowlist.

getAllowlistLength().notice: Returns the number of addresses in the allowlist.

getAllowlistPaginated(uint256,uint256).notice: Returns paginated addresses in the allowlist.

getDistributionCount().notice: Returns the total number of distributions.

isAllowlisted(address).notice: Checks if an address is in the allowlist.

merkleSnapshot().notice: Address of the MerkleSnapshot contract to query for merkle state

owner().notice: The address that can update the distribution parameters.

pendingFeePercentage().notice: A scheduled fee-percentage increase (M-7). Zero `pendingFeeEffectiveAt` = none.

pendingOwner().notice: The pending owner address (for 2-step ownership transfer).

setAllowlistEnabled(bool).notice: Sets the `allowlistEnabled` of the contract to `allowlistEnabled_`.

setFeePercentage(uint256).notice: Sets the `feePercentage` of the contract to `newFeePercentage`.

setFeeRecipient(address).notice: Sets the `feeRecipient` of the contract to `newFeeRecipient`.

setMerkleSnapshot(address).notice: Sets the `merkleSnapshot` of the contract to `newMerkleSnapshot`.

sweep(uint256).notice: Sweeps the unclaimed remainder of an expired distribution back to the round funder.

updateDistributorAllowance(address,bool).notice: Updates a distributor's ability to distribute funds.
